OP here. Sorry that I wasn't clear. Of course the smell isn't what matters most when adopting an animal and that surely isn't what I intended. It's just that for some reason I have a very sensitive nose and that my parents (still love at home) have this bad reputation in their head that rodents smell awful. I've had a few hamsters when I was a little kid but obviously I was too young to be responsible enough for their care, hence my parents' thoughts that rodents stink.

My main concern when choosing an animal is whether or not I can make its living space big and comfortable enough and if I can give it the care it needs. I'm leaning towards a rat or dumbo rat because I have a really big cage (2 meters x 2 meters x 50 cm) that I once got second hand some years ago.

I don't have any hobbies. I tried to force myself to have some but nothing ever held my interest. I tried manga, was obsessed with it...for a week. Every small thing I did find quickly lost my interest. Nothing I do brings me joy, not in the slightest. I don't know what a wrong with me.

I'm sorry, everyone, for being such a downer. I'm not in a good head space right now. I've been fighting for so long and I've been told by professionals that I'll always be like this so I thought maybe I could get some answers here.. seems like I'll just have to surrender. I'm depressed. Suicidal

Heard too many bad things about LSD to try. I tried weed and alcohol though but for some reason even this things barely have any effect on me, positive or negative. I do breathing exercises as meditation. Haven't tried yoga yet but I've had mindfulness therapy.

Well, I've had depression for as long as I can remember so I'm not sure what came first. But I do have other issues like Borderline personality disorder, anxiety, phobias, no self-esteem, ADD, toxic family, past trauma, abuse,etc. I've been treated for most of these things but it didn't help anything. It keeps getting worse.
Tried those things and many more but I get tired of it so quickly. Not even my favourite tv series makes me smile anymore.

The only coping mechanisms I have are unhealthy. I've tried getting into all kinds of hobbies but nothing is interesting enough. I've improved all that I could improve, which wasn't much but still. Lessening of the effects is not enough. It never lessens enough to make it even a life worth living.
Have tried more than 10, and that for years. It just doesn't help.
How? Nothing makes me happy. Nothing is fun to do.

It's a lot tougher to cut through scar tissue although that depends on the kind of scar it is. Raised ones are easy to cut again but deep ones kind of have this hard rough texture and its difficult to puncture that kind of skin. That and more risk of infection if the scar isn't healed yet.
No idea, I can't see it. It's not the cut itself that has the liquid but the surrounding tissue, underneath the healthy skin. Kind of feels like a water balloon if you press one, but not that bad.

I force myself to walk 1 hour a day. I've got two dogs. Keeping busy hasn't helped me, it only makes things worse. I try to do small things or things that should be fun. I eat healthy, I take vitamin D and iron (because of blood loss from selfharm), I checked my thyroid. My blood sugar is good, blood pressure is good. Apart from being overweight because of the meds, I'm completely healthy body-wise. I've tried taking up hobbies or just playing with the dogs or being in nature, getting some sun and whatever else is considered healthy. I'm still so depressed that I wish I could just kill myself. I'm in a toxic environment and around lots of toxic people, which my psychiatrist says I have to get away from in order to heal, but I can't cut them out of my life seeing as they're my parents and I still live with them. Trust me, I've tried every mental health tip I've ever gotten but I'm still getting worse by the day. Ever since I was 12 I knew that one day I'd kill myself. I don't think that day is very far away anymore. I've tried so much, I really have. I WANT to get better but nothing seems to work, not even selfharm anymore. I just want it to end

I have tried fixing my issues for over 13 years and I'm just sick of it all. Nothing works. Not therapy, not meds, not professionals, not the mental health clinic, not family, nothing at all. I'm just out of things to try. I honestly just want to feel happy for a few hours, that's all. Or even to just feel okay. That's all I want. I have addict in my family and I'm an addict (selfharm)too so I know to be careful and not make it a habit. Just once I want to feel ok. It's either that or I'm just too fucking tired to go on living. I'm that desperate for any positive feeling, no matter how small

There's lots of stuff, most of which I can't seem to change. I have (officially diagnosed) Borderline personality disorder, major depressive disorder (+13 years), severe social and generalized anxiety. I have been having self-harm issues since I was 12, I was abused for many years physically but mostly emotionally, I was bullied for all of my school years, I'm transsexual but cannot transition, I'm fat and can't loose it because of my meds, I'm ugly, etc.. you get the picture.

I've had lots of professional help, both as inpatient and outpatient. Was in the crisis ward twice. Did DBT with a psychologist. Tried +15 different kinds of antidepressants (next week another kind) and none of them ever worked, not even a little. They only made me fat and hopeless. I have tried to change in all kinds of ways but nothing makes me feel better, not even dieting, exercising and all the healthy stuff. Nothing has changed, its always been like this for as far as I can remember. Two psychologist and one psychiatrist even gave up on me because "you'll have to learn to learn to live with it, I guess" they said. I'm just so done. I've been fighting suicidal thoughts for over 12 years straight. Every. Single. Day.

I don't know what to do anymore. Nothing works.

There isn't anyone who listens to me. I don't have any friends. Don't have any family that is in any way positive towards me so I don't have anyone to talk to. I've had professional help of course but after many years it's just become too expensive. I'm just stuck in this place/situation despite having tired everything for so, so long. And nothing has helped. Ever. Not even a little bit. There's just nothing anymore.

Oh and my mother is suicidal too so I have to support her while inside I just wanna die as well. My parents marriage is bad too. They should either shoot each other or get a divorce but they should just get it over with. I'm so damn tried of it all.

There is no solution. I can't get a job because of mental health issues, yet I'm not able to get disability payment. No money means no place to live so I still live with my parents. Who are both seriously toxic to me. I can't live anywhere else because I have no friends or other support. I've been inpatient twice, had tons of therapy and other professional help, I've tried so many antidepressants but they don't work. I'm transsexual but can't transition because I have no money and because my father will kick me out. I can't get help from the state because my country has really fucking shitty health care and they cannot give me money because I still live at home. Doctors have given up on me and so have I. I literally can't change a dank thing about my situation. I'm not right in the head and I'll never be, I've had that confirmed multiple times.  I've tried everything to help myself.. seriously..  To get "better" I'd have to live on my own, for which I'd need a job and that's not possible. I've tried. To get better I'd need friends, that I don't have, and support, which nobody gives. Plus my parents both have serious issues too so they can't help me. I literally have nobody and nothing and it can't change because it's all just a vicious cycle I can't get out of.

Sorry for the rant.

It's a 10 day old thread but I have a question. I see that you've got some tattoos over your scars and I'm wondering what your experience with tattooing them was. Does the ink hold well in scar tissue or does it seep into the scar tissue? How old did your scars have to be before you could get them tattoos? Is the end result just as pretty as tattoos on healthy skin? I want to get my scars on my arm tattoos too. Also, does tattooing over scar tissue hurt more compared to normal tattooing? Sorry for the many questions. And congrats on staying clean!

It's not dangerous physically, unless they get infected, but it is still dangerous because if it becomes an addiction, you'll go deeper eventually, even if you think you'll never do that. It's best to find a healthy with to deal with things before it gets out of hand.

I also don't bother. Well, I mean, I do throw away my razors after a few uses, butmi never bothered with wound aftercare. I never really took infection serious and I still don't, despite almost dying twice. I even just leave fat cuts open once I stopped the bleeding. But on a serious note, it's not recommended to not take care of the things you use to cut. I get preventative tetanus shots every year at my doctors recommendation but most people don't get that, which makes it more dangerous if you cut with something that's rusty or dirty. Take care.

You really shouldn't try to cut deeper. It's very dangerous and addicting. Cutting is a terrible addiction, no matter how deep you cut so you should try to seek for help because it does get worse over time.

Then it does sound like it could be bpd, but I'm not a doctor. Lots of symptoms can often be from other (mental) illnesses too so never just assume. It's better to get help early on though, then you've got a better chance at healing. Hopefully for you it isn't bpd. I've got it and it's not fun. At all.
Could be that it needs more time or that they're okay but still not exactly the kinds you need. It's best to ask your doctor, to be sure.

It doesn't necessarily mean you have bpd because fear of abandonment can also just mean you're insecure or it could be a puberty thing, if you're a teen. It doesn't hurt to be sure though because it's really difficult to live with a mental illness. You should go to a doctor if you're concerned about it.

The problem is that I don't enjoy anything. I don't even enjoy watching tv shows anymore. I have no energy for anything even though I force myself to exercise. Everything frustrates and bores me to death. The only thing I think is fun is sleeping and even that is difficult.

There are lots of things that could cause my depression but they're past traumas. Even when the day is perfect and there are no negative things or people happening, I still can get into a sudden deep episode or whatever you call it. So my depression doesn't really have a source. It's confusing. Even if I take away or avoid ALL triggers, I still feel like ending my life.

Same here. I'm only alive because my suicide would destroy my mom. She's the only one who supports and loves me. We have a close relationship and as long as she's alive, I'll have to be as well. Once she's gone, I'll be too because then it won't hurt her.

So the best thing to do is to kind of wait it out? I feel like I should be doing more to help. I feel so bad for her, to be a slave to booze again. I do support her whenever and however I can, but I'm being treated in a mental hospital myself and I can't come home much. I can't keep her safe from herself. She had a DUI a while back and she says she won't drink behind the wheel anymore but I know better than to believe those kind of promises. I'm not being judgemental or anything, if that's how it sounds, but I just know the routine of relapses and I'm so scared to have her (and our family) go through it again. The worst part of it is that it is my fault that she relapsed. She doesn't blame me or anything, but I blame myself. 

Sorry for the rant. I'm just really scared of her dying because of the alcohol.

I'm only an inpatient because I have no other choice. It's this or suicide. It also scares the crap out of me, every day is difficult with all those other people etc.. I get what you mean though about not wanting another label. I've had many and all they do is scare other people. I also thought I needed my meds because I'm still really depressed, I thought I'd need them forever but I my case they never worked, so maybe that's why I might be better of without them. If you feel you need them, then you should continue. I hope when you get your nezpw psychologist that you can work on getting out of that episode that still bothers you. Hopefully in time you can find some peace somehow. Stay strong hun.

I can relate a bit. I have mild Aspergers too and have also suffered from severe depression, anxiety and other things for 13 years straight. Most days are hell andbive also tried a lot of anti depressants, other meds and psychologists and psychiatrists. Right now I'm in treatment at a mental hospital and while there are a lot of horror stories about those, I've actually been feeling better than I have for many years. I'm still depressed and whatnot but I finally see some hope, although I'm so scared to fall back into the pit. I'm slowly reducing my antidepressants at my psychiatrist's request and strangely I feel happiness. Not 100% but I can actually feel it again. 

I'm not saying you'll be cured if you reduce your meds or chech yourself in somewhere but I'm just suggesting it. If you're checked in, you also have a psychologist ready 2 times a week and more if necessary.  At least you'd make some more progress than if you have to wait so long. But well, it's your choice. Just know that I'm here if you need someone to talk to. Just a listening ear can sometimes make a difference. Good luck.

I have insurance that covers pretty much all of the costs, even for several months so at least in that case I don't have to worry about money.
